Name: RRRR Gender Neutrality Patch
Author: MoonyIsTired
Description:
[b]DESCRIPTION:

[/b]A simple mod to change all gendered terms from RRRR into gender neutral terms. This mostly edited dialogue on the "female" farmer side, but a few "male" dialogues have been edited as well (example: despite RRRR being mostly gender neutral when it comes to "male" farmers, it still refers to them as Mister and Uncle in some instances. These have been changed to match the default Gender Neutrality Mod Tokens, Mx. and Cousin.)

This edit was created for personal use, and as such many personal choices have been made regarding terms that refer to the farmer.

One singular dialogue that infers the farmer's biological [i]sex[/i] instead of gender has been left alone on the "female" farmer side. You'll only ever encounter this if you have the content set to "true" in the main mod. On a somewhat related note, while editing the file, I've decided I really like being called a creature, actually.

This is being uploaded with permission from the original mod creator.

[b]INSTALLATION:[/b]

[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]﻿[/*]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16893]RRRR[/url]﻿ and their necessary dependencies.[/*]
[*]Download and unzip this mod into RRRR's mod folder. It should replace the i18n folder. It will not work on its own[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/*]
[/list]
[b]COMPATIBILITY:

[/b]This is just a i18n translation folder. It is compatible with, and of course requires, the original RRRR mod folder. This is being uploaded with 1.8.59 in mind. If the original mod is ever updated again, I'll try to also keep this mod updated as well. However, as I edited this mostly for personal use, it might depend on whether or not I'm still playing with it, and I'm known to play non-stop for a few weeks and then drop the game for several months.
